name: Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite Mastercard®

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 intro annual fee for the first 12 months of account opening, then $99

apr.notes: The variable APR for purchases is 19.49% – 28.49%, based on your creditworthiness. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 29.99%. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Cash advance fee – either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 AAdvantage® mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases

categories.label: Gas stations and car rental merchants
Telecommunications merchants, cable and satellite providers

rewards.redemption_notes: AAdvantage® miles can be redeemed for future business travel, upgrades and more. Each cardmember earns one Loyalty Point for every $1 spent on business card purchases.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 65,000 American Airlines AAdvantage® bonus miles. Bonus miles earned after you or your employees spend $4,000 in purchases within the first 4 months of account opening.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: First checked bag is free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for you and up to 4 travel companions on the same reservation.

benefits.title: Preferred boarding
benefits.description: Enjoy preferred boarding on American Airlines flights so you can save time and be more productive.

benefits.title: Add employees as authorized users
benefits.description: Earn more AAdvantage® miles with purchases made by employees on authorized user cards and stay in control with individual spend limits.

benefits.title: Mastercard special offers
benefits.description: Save money and increase everyday efficiency with special offers on business solutions available with your Mastercard.

benefits.title: Save 25% on select inflight purchases
benefits.description: Enjoy 25% savings on inflight Wi-Fi, food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights when you use your credit card.

benefits.title: Earn an American Airlines Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Earn an American Airlines Companion Certificate for domestic travel after you spend $30,000 or more in purchases each cardmembership year and cardmembership is renewed. Redeeming the certificate costs $99 for the ticketing fee plus taxes and fees.

benefits.title: AAdvantage Business™ membership benefits
benefits.description: Book and manage business travel easily on aa.com. Your membership also includes travel management tools with essential reporting capabilities, duty of care, traveler activity, expense management and more.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Shop like a local wherever you go with your Citi® / AAdvantage Business™ credit card.

benefits.title: Business tools
benefits.description: Access online account summaries to track expenses. Check your balance anytime and use your card on the go with access to the Citi mobile® App and Mobile Wallet.
